dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: I'm pretty happy with how things have gone. Actually, make that delighted... Hehe, didn't expect to reach the Upper Sanctum.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: I originally thought I'd just about make it to the entrance below for a quick look around...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #It was all thanks to you, {M#lad}{F#lass}. And to think, what a waste it would have been if I'd gone to all the trouble of sneaking out but not seen a thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... What do you mean by "sneaking out"?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Okay, so here's the thing... I left without telling my friends and family in the tribe...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Oh, didn't I tell you before?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, isn't that running away from home!?
